title: Pehli Naukri - 60-second test
synopsis: Original one-minute scene written for testing GlobalDub. Riya gets a big job offer in Mumbai, but her brother Kabir has been hiding that their father's shop is in debt. Cliffhanger: the bank arrives early.

characters.name: Riya
characters.persona: Bright, determined younger sister who has just landed her first job.

characters.name: Kabir
characters.persona: Protective elder brother quietly carrying the family's money worries.

characters.name: Dadi
characters.persona: Warm grandmother, sharp when it matters.

glossary.note: Elder brother; in Western languages use his name

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: भैया! मुझे मुंबई वाली नौकरी मिल गई, पूरे बारह लाख का पैकेज!

reference.en-US: Kabir! I got the Mumbai job, a full 1.2 million rupee package!

lines.speaker: Kabir
lines.text: सच में? अरे वाह, तूने तो कमाल कर दिया!

reference.en-US: Seriously? Wow, you totally nailed it!

lines.speaker: Dadi
lines.text: मेरी बच्ची... आज तो घर में घी के दीये जलाने चाहिए।

reference.en-US: My girl... today calls for a real celebration.

lines.speaker: Kabir
lines.text: रिया... तुझे एक बात बतानी थी।

reference.en-US: Riya... there's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: क्या हुआ भैया? आप इतने परेशान क्यों हो?

reference.en-US: What's wrong, Kabir? Why do you look so worried?

lines.speaker: Kabir
lines.text: पापा की दुकान पर दो लाख का कर्ज़ है। बैंक ने सात दिन दिए हैं।

reference.en-US: Dad's shop owes 200,000 rupees. The bank gave us seven days.

lines.speaker: Dadi
lines.text: हे भगवान! तुमने ये बात हमसे छुपाई?

reference.en-US: Oh my God! You hid this from us?

lines.speaker: Kabir
lines.text: मैं नहीं चाहता था कि रिया अपना सपना छोड़ दे।

reference.en-US: I didn't want Riya to give up her dream.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: सपना कहीं नहीं जाएगा। परिवार पहले है, भैया।

reference.en-US: My dream isn't going anywhere. Family comes first, Kabir.

lines.speaker: Dadi
lines.text: कबीर... बैंक वाला आदमी दरवाज़े पर खड़ा है।

reference.en-US: Kabir... the man from the bank is at the door.

lines.speaker: Kabir
lines.text: अभी? पर उन्होंने तो सात दिन कहा था...

reference.en-US: Now? But they said seven days...
